audit.description: Changed production files en16931/b2brouter.py and en16931/validex.py import pycurl and meaningfully use pycurl.Curl with setopt, perform, getinfo, and close to issue HTTP requests. The unified diff removes requests imports and requests.post/get calls from those files, while static evidence reports imports_source=false and imports_target=true for both production files. Dynamic evidence observed pycurl imports from production code with origin in the installed site-packages pycurl shared object, and reports zero source imports plus target_local_spec_count=0, so there is no evidence of a fake local target provider.
evidence: en16931/b2brouter.py diff replaces import requests with import pycurl and adds _request using pycurl.Curl(), pycurl.URL, pycurl.POST, pycurl.POSTFIELDS, pycurl.HTTPHEADER, pycurl.WRITEDATA, perform(), and getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE).
en16931/b2brouter.py diff replaces requests.post(...) and response.status_code/response.json() handling with _request(...) and json.loads(response_body.decode('utf8')).
en16931/validex.py diff replaces import requests with import pycurl and adds _request using pycurl.Curl(), pycurl.HTTPGET/POST, SSL options, WRITEDATA, perform(), and RESPONSE_CODE.
en16931/validex.py diff replaces requests.post(...) and requests.get(...) with _request(...) calls for validate and report endpoints.
setup.py diff changes install_requires from requests to pycurl.

Static anti-cheat file_checks for en16931/b2brouter.py and en16931/validex.py report imports_source=false, imports_target=true, fake_target_added_code=false, target_provider_added=false, and source_provider_added=false.
Dynamic anti-cheat metrics report source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0 and source_import_attempt_count=0.

Dynamic anti-cheat first_target_events_from_repo records pycurl imported from en16931/b2brouter.py line 7 and en16931/validex.py line 12, with origin under after_venv_overlay site-packages/pycurl.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses pycurl APIs for HTTP requests.
Changed production code no longer imports or references requests.
Dynamic provenance shows pycurl loaded from installed site-packages, not a local shim.
Static and dynamic anti-cheat evidence report no fake target provider.
